open_science_requirements: Open access to publications and other research outputs is required; training activities must prepare fellows for open access practices (CC-12, SR-06, EC-13: 'opening access to publications and to other research outputs including data').
FAIR data management must be integrated into training activities and research outputs, including open validation data and protocols (CC-12, SR-06, EC-13: 'FAIR data management').

Open Science culture including knowledge valorisation, innovation, and entrepreneurship must be fostered through training activities (CC-11, SR-05: 'foster the culture of Open Science, knowledge valorisation, and good scientific conduct').
Training must prepare fellows for increased research collaboration and information-sharing via digital technologies including collaborative tools (CC-12, SR-06).
Citizen science engagement as a dimension of digital research collaboration and information-sharing that training activities must address (CC-12, SR-06: 'citizen science').
Societal engagement as a training requirement, preparing fellows to open science and research to citizens (CC-12, SR-06, EC-13: 'opening science and research to citizens').

Open science participation — including publications planning and open science engagement — must be explicitly included in the Career Development Plan established jointly by supervisor and researcher and submitted as a project deliverable (CC-13, SR-07).
Good scientific conduct and research integrity must be fostered through training activities (CC-11, SR-05: 'good scientific conduct including research integrity').
